principle: Foundry owns routing, task state, manifests, report compatibility, and policy checks. Reusable deterministic import, conversion, and validation logic belongs to unified Rust tidas; reusable AI context, QA, curation, remote, skill, database, and API behavior remains with its owning project.

owns: native tidas executable/config selection and stable report/exit compatibility
locked TIDAS schema and methodology assets
external LCA package parsing and format detection
stable operation reports, batch-validation protocol, exit classes, cancellation, and atomic publication
compatibility SDK and contract/context APIs for consumers that do not execute deterministic import or validation
QA, reference, publish, and verification commands

use_when: AI needs full schema text, methodology YAML, runtime rulesets, or a stable context pack
the input is a supported packaged LCA dataset
candidate TIDAS documents require deterministic schema validation
the input is PDF, Excel, image, web export, screenshot, or free text

decision_rules.route_to: tiangong-ai/skills via pnpm dlx skills runtime resolution
use_when: the task needs fast-moving Tiangong AI document extraction or KB research workflows such as source-document fulltext extraction or SCI literature evidence retrieval
examples: pnpm dlx skills@latest use https://github.com/tiangong-ai/skills --skill document-granular-decompose --full-depth
pnpm dlx skills@latest use https://github.com/tiangong-ai/skills --skill tiangong-kb-sci-search --full-depth

use_when: the change only selects capabilities, records manifests, updates task state, or checks policy
